title: Cart Badge Text
prompt: A React header renders a shopping cart badge. Write a helper that returns an empty string for 0 items, the count as a string for 1 through 99 items, and "99+" for anything above 99.

explanation.beginner:
Example: cartBadgeText(0) produces "". The result must follow this precise rule: A React header renders a shopping cart badge. Write a helper that returns an empty string for 0 items, the count as a string for 1 through 99 items, and "99+" for anything above 99. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “shows normal counts”: input [12] produces "12". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
